cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group-level cash is not split between listed parent, Hong Kong/offshore subsidiaries and PRC operating subsidiaries; 2025 annual report states cash and fixed deposits situated in Chinese Mainland were HKD 1,810.874m and remittance is subject to FX control.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially usable cash, but not fully detachable without affecting working capital or proving upstreamability.

cash_breakdown.item: Fixed deposits with banks with more than three months to maturity when placed
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Bank fixed deposits over three months; term and PRC/offshore split are not disclosed separately, so use middle of 0.60-0.95 range.
cash_breakdown.reason: Bank deposits are funds assets but require liquidity, maturity and remittance haircut.

cash_breakdown.item: Current other financial assets - principal-guaranteed structured deposit products
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Products are issued by principal banker with guaranteed principal and floating return; treated as bank structured deposits with 0.60-0.85 default range.

cash_breakdown.item: Current other financial assets - listed equity securities in Hong Kong
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Listed equity securities are liquid but market price can move; use 0.50-0.80 range.
cash_breakdown.reason: Can likely be sold without affecting manufacturing operations, subject to market haircut.

cash_breakdown.item: Non-current other financial assets - unlisted equity securities outside Hong Kong
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Unlisted equity is not cash-like and may not have a realistic disposal path; use 0.00-0.40 range.
cash_breakdown.reason: Included only at de minimis conservative value.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report states these deposits are restricted under conditions.
Interest-bearing bank loans are deducted at 100%; HKD 193m is secured by subsidiary land, buildings, machinery and equipment.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financing debt must be repaid or assumed by controlling buyer.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Lease liabilities are included as debt in financing reconciliation; small and deducted conservatively.
cash_breakdown.reason: Continuing lease obligations reduce freely extractable funds.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Manufacturing business has 52 inventory days, 62 debtor days, HKD 13.96bn revenue and large supplier/customer working-capital cycle; reserve approximates one month of cash operating needs after considering trade payables.
cash_breakdown.reason: Needed to keep operations running after acquisition.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Funds include PRC subsidiaries and multiple currencies; reserve covers remittance, withholding, FX and distribution friction not separately quantified in the annual report.
cash_breakdown.reason: Friction deduction before treating cash as detachable.

profit_quality.assessment: Use a conservative owner cash profit base of HKD 300m: below the 2023-2025 median parent profit of HKD 391m and close to 2025 operating free cash flow after PPE and intangible capex of HKD 315m. Apply 0.75 haircut because profits are cash-generative over three years but automotive display manufacturing requires continuing capex and working capital.
adjustments: Excluded reliance on interest income from deposits and fair-value gains on other financial assets when setting sustainable cash profit.
Used 2025 operating cash flow of HKD 797.949m less PPE/intangible capex of HKD 482.489m as a recent-year cash anchor.
Recognized working-capital reinvestment in 2025: inventories increased HKD 56.865m and receivables/deposits/prepayments increased HKD 99.939m, partly offset by payables increase.
Customer concentration remains relevant: one customer contributed approximately HKD 3.177bn, more than 10% of revenue.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023-2025 operating cash flow was HKD 1,186.078m, HKD 1,456.688m and HKD 797.949m; after PPE and intangible purchases, rough free cash flow was HKD 677.894m, HKD 880.308m and HKD 315.460m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable positive CFO supports cash profit, but 2025 profit declined, capex remains material and working capital is tied to customer receivables/inventory.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year CFO / parent profit ratio is about 2.04x, but 2024 was helped by a large increase in payables and should not be fully capitalized.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No explicit maintenance capex split; use 2025 PPE and intangible purchases of HKD 482.489m as conservative current-year capex anchor.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 inventory and receivable/deposit/prepayment increases together absorbed HKD 156.804m before the payables offset.
